text:
An efficient run ahead, good news
The subject is bedding supplies
Travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways should note that bedding arrangements for companion animals must be confirmed before departure. We ask each traveler to review the comfort items listed for the booking and to share any changes with staff as soon as possible.

Our team records each service adjustment in the desk ledger so that the travel plan stays accurate from check-in to arrival. This helps the senior coordinator prepare the cabin area, support the animal's welfare, and keep the handover smooth for the flight crew. When the request is clear, the desk can move with confidence and avoid delay.

If you are traveling with a pet, please keep all bedding items clean, secure, and ready for inspection. Any special support needed for the journey should be reported in advance so it may be added to the service notes. We appreciate your cooperation and remain ready to assist with calm, careful planning for every companion animal booking.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk if you need help with bedding supplies or any related travel arrangement.
